title: native_fix_1b
source_method: INEGI current AGEEML; IGN/INDEC BAHRA; DANE DIVIPOLA. Own-code binding or a unique exact normalized name, state and point within 1 km. The only normalized characters are case, accents and whitespace. INEGI municipio labels may carry the explicitly recorded structural type prefix Municipio de; no toponym or parenthetical qualifier is discarded. Own item redirects are held. Names use the places written case, not register uppercase. Accent differences are decided from the official record and own Spanish label; retain an accent unless both omit it.
